opening_question_spark: What happens if you sleep under five hours, then push through your morning watering?
book_transition: I want to see what gives way first.
cta: Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
body: Your attention slows, making simple tasks harder to track.
New memories become harder to form.
Reaction time drops, raising the risk of accidents.
Your mood can become more irritable or low.
Hunger hormones shift, making calorie-dense foods more tempting.
Repeated short nights can worsen blood sugar control.
Blood pressure may creep upward over time.
Your immune system can become less effective.
Exhaustion can trigger brief microsleeps without warning.
During one, your brain briefly stops responding normally.
One short night usually causes temporary problems.
But regularly sleeping under five hours can compound the strain.
optional_closing: Sleep is not empty time; it is essential maintenance.
